_meta.description: Search query templates for IP novelty screening. Replace {{KEYWORDS}}, {{DOMAIN}}, {{PROBLEM}}, {{SOLUTION}} with idea-specific terms.
_meta.usage: The LLM should generate 3-5 search queries by filling in these templates based on the invention idea.

patent_searches.name: google_patents_problem
patent_searches.template: site:patents.google.com {{PROBLEM}} device OR method OR system
patent_searches.purpose: Find patents addressing the same problem

patent_searches.name: patent_landscape
patent_searches.purpose: Find patent mentions across the web

product_searches.name: existing_products
product_searches.purpose: Find existing products in the space

product_searches.name: kickstarter_indiegogo
product_searches.purpose: Check crowdfunding platforms for similar products

product_searches.name: startup_search
product_searches.purpose: Find startups working on similar solutions

market_searches.name: market_size
market_searches.template: {{DOMAIN}} market size 2025 OR 2026 OR forecast OR "billion"

market_searches.name: industry_trends
market_searches.template: {{DOMAIN}} trends 2026 OR emerging OR growing OR disrupting

market_searches.name: target_audience
market_searches.template: "{{PROBLEM}}" consumer OR user OR customer survey OR research

academic_searches.name: arxiv_preprints
academic_searches.purpose: Check academic preprints for prior research

academic_searches.name: google_scholar
academic_searches.purpose: Find academic papers on the topic
